title: A Tail Structure Associated with a Protoplanetary Disk around SU Aurigae
question: Is there a CO (J=2-1) gas counterpart to the tail-like structure seen in scattered light around the SU Aur disk, is it kinematically connected to the disk, and what could have produced it?

what.value: Subaru H-band polarized intensity of the tail, overlaid on CO map

evidence.quote: with Subaru H-band polarized intensity (PI) (de Leon et al. 2015) in dark color contour
the dust mass in the tail-like structure is estimated to be ∼ 6 × 10 [−][8] M ⊙ (de Leon et al. 2015)
the disk mass can be 9.0 × 10 [−][2] M ⊙ under assumption of gas to dust ratio of 100 (Ricci et al. 2010)

recipe.method: Self-calibrate on continuum, apply tables to line data, CLEAN with Briggs weighting, primary beam correction

recipe.goal: Make moment maps, channel maps and velocity profiles
recipe.method: Moments 0,1,2 from channels 1.87-10.87 km/s above 30 mJy/beam; velocity and dispersion curves along the tail; disk spectrum within 1.2 arcsec radius

recipe.goal: Subtract Keplerian disk model from moment 1
recipe.method: Simple flat Keplerian disk model in same orientation, subtracted from observed moment 1 map in the disk region
From a channel-map panel with beam size and CO(2-1) rest frequency

evidence.quote: a tail-like structure more than 1000 au long extending from the northern part of the disk body to the southwest direction
The disk component has a peak intensity of 400 mJy beam [−][1] km s [−][1] in CO (J=2–1) emission
whose peak intensity of 850 mJy beam [−][1] , as displayed in white contour
The tail component has a velocity dispersion of ∼ 0.7 km s [−][1] whereas the disk component has ∼ 2 km s [−][1] .
the brightness temperature is about 16 K

not_stated_but_needed: Calibrator for flux scale and the flux uncertainty
Pipeline vs manual calibration and whether delivered products were used
Self-calibration solution intervals and number of rounds
Image size, cell size, masking, clean threshold, and deconvolver
Whether the image cube was smoothed or rebinned to ~0.3 km/s channels
Moment-map clipping beyond 30 mJy/beam and the channel range used for moment 0
Keplerian model parameters (stellar mass, inclination, PA, outer radius)
score_reason: Public data and basic imaging settings are given, but many parameters for imaging, modelling and profile extraction are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public and moment maps and the tail detection are reproducible, though some settings are missing.
